'''Gigauns''' were enormous, yet harmless, creatures native to the planet [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]]. They were also known as '''hatchet heads''' by the local workers. They were essential to Ukio's ecosystem, as they possessed subsonic cells within their bodies which caused seeds to germinate, as the gigauns moved along their migration routes.

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] on Ukio, when the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|tactical droid]] [[Doctor (tactical droid)|Doctor]] launched the second phase of [[Project Instinction]], herds of gigauns wandered off their normal paths and near the fields of crops, threatening to crush them beneath their feet.
